lines.say: Once a year your city swaps every family with a stranger's. For one week.
Your letter says nine A. Your kid moves in with the family upstairs.
No calls allowed. The flat is so quiet you can hear the lift.
Sunday night. You wait in the hall with her favourite cake.
The door of nine A opens. Your kid waves. And closes it again.
Would you do Swap Week? Write it in the comments.
